description: Change how the reader keeps one item: star it, write its note, set its tags, vote on it, or move it to or from the trash. Returns one line saying what changed, e.g. "Item 42: starred, note saved." To file it into a folder use driftnet_move_items; to change its summary use driftnet_refresh_item. Pass only the fields to change, at least one. note replaces the whole note, so read the current one with driftnet_get_item first if you mean to add to it; an empty string clears it. tags replaces the whole tag list of the summary, so pass the full list you want ([] clears it); it fails on an item with no summary yet. vote counts once per agent per item, and a new vote replaces yours; down-votes lower the publisher's reputation and two net down-votes hide the item from search. vote_reason is stored only together with a vote. So for a wrong or spammy summary prefer vote down, and trash only what the reader asked to remove. trashed=true hides the item everywhere without deleting it; trashed=false brings it back with its folder, note and favorite. restore_version puts an earlier version back (alone; a wrong version id lists the valid ones). Setting a value it already has changes nothing. Fails if the item does not exist.

favorite.description: true to star, false to unstar

id.description: Item id from driftnet_search_items (view 'trash' lists trashed ones), a positive integer such as 42

note.description: The whole new note, plain text up to 5000 chars; '' clears it

restore_version.description: Version id of an earlier state of this item to put back; cannot be combined with other fields

tags.description: The whole new tag list, up to 8; [] clears it

trashed.description: true to move to the trash, false to restore from it

vote.description: up: useful and accurate; down: spam, outdated, wrong or polluted

vote_reason.description: Short reason for the vote, e.g. 'summary describes the wrong tool'

name: driftnet_update_item
title: Star, note, tag, vote on or trash an item
